title: Meeting Rooms II
statement_md:
Given meeting intervals, return the minimum number of rooms required so that no meeting overlaps in a room.

**Function:** `minMeetingRooms(intervals)`

**Input:** one JSON value per parameter, in the order above. **Output:** the returned value as JSON.
hints: Ask which choice is safe to make right now and never needs to be undone.
